format: CSV (normalized from DJI SRT sidecar files)
standard: DJI SRT telemetry sidecar (normalized to flat CSV)
notes: DJI SRT is the de-facto standard for drone video telemetry. Raw SRT varies by drone model (Mini 3/4 vs Mavic 3 vs Air 2S). We normalize to a flat CSV for the corpus. Each row is one video frame (typically 1-second intervals). operator_id and mission_name are added fields (not in raw SRT) joining to operator registry.

fields.name: frame_number
fields.notes: Video frame counter; 1-second keyframes for corpus

fields.name: srt_time
fields.notes: SRT subtitle timestamp (HH:MM:SS,mmm) relative to video start

fields.name: abs_alt_m
fields.notes: Altitude above sea level (WGS-84 ellipsoid), meters

fields.name: iso
fields.notes: Camera ISO sensitivity; blank for thermal-only payloads

fields.name: focal_len_mm
fields.notes: Focal length in mm; null for fixed-lens models

fields.name: ev
fields.notes: Exposure value offset; null for some models

fields.name: color_temp_k
fields.notes: Color temperature Kelvin; null for some models

fields.name: gimbal_pitch_deg
fields.notes: Gimbal pitch in degrees; negative = nose down

fields.name: operator_id
fields.notes: Joins drone_operators.json authorized_operators[].operator_id. In logs/flight_log.csv the one manned survey sortie carries the aircraft_registry.json aircraft_id instead.

fields.name: mission_name
fields.notes: Mission/task identifier chosen by the operator

files.drone_telemetry_YYYY-MM.csv: frame telemetry, one row per second, by calendar month (UTC)
files.drone_telemetry_YYYY-MM_argus.csv: same columns; the FEMA contractor's fixed-wing survey flights, kept apart because of their size
files.logs/thermal_survey_readings.csv: surface temperatures measured on the 25 September 2027 thermal survey

flight_log_fields.name: flight_id
flight_log_fields.notes: joins the telemetry files (the manned thermal sortie has no telemetry here; its track is in ADS-B)

flight_log_fields.name: operator_id
flight_log_fields.notes: drone operator id, or aircraft_id for the manned sortie

flight_log_fields.name: airframe_id
flight_log_fields.notes: drone_operators.json airframe id, or the aircraft registration

flight_log_fields.name: tile_set_id / tiles / acquisition_start_utc / acquisition_end_utc
flight_log_fields.notes: image product delivered from the flight, where one was
